subject.title: Feature: configurable dateFormat (UK/US/ISO) for envelope and system-event date display

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `agents.defaults.dateFormat` display setting for envelope and system-event dates, and if so should the scope be limited to prompt-facing display dates with ISO as the default?
rationale: The requested implementation is mechanically small, but it adds public config surface and changes model-visible timestamp text, which repository policy treats as a maintainer product decision rather than a safe automatic fix.

options.title: Approve Narrow Display Setting
options.body: Add `dateFormat` with ISO default and a small enum, applying it only to envelope and system-event display dates while leaving machine-readable timestamps and filenames unchanged.

options.title: Keep ISO-Only Core
options.body: Reject a core config knob for now and document that operators should keep ISO prompt dates or use an external post-processing/plugin workaround at their own risk.

options.title: Defer To Broader Time Preferences
options.body: Hold this issue until a wider date/time preference design covers Control UI, TUI, memory/session artifacts, and agent prompt display consistently.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Display Setting
recommendation.body: Add `dateFormat` with ISO default and a small enum, applying it only to envelope and system-event display dates while leaving machine-readable timestamps and filenames unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about public config and prompt timestamp product behavior, and this person has the clearest history on the envelope config and prior date-format discussion.
